641:t_006:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Here we come, $$サイデリアル$$!」

641:t_006:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We won't let you stop us! We're setting out for the galaxy to protect Earth... to protect everyone!」

641:t_007:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't think you can stop us now with just this much!」

641:t_007:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't let your guard down. I can't believe their attack ends here.」

641:t_007:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The dimensional boundary line is distorting again! This is...!」

641:t_008:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$!」

641:t_008:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ランド$$ had to go and run his mouth, and now a real pain has shown up!」

641:t_009:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Exactly, human. Whatever you people do is meaningless before the war between gods and demons.」

641:t_010:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「But you have opened the door to the forbidden.」

641:t_010:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That is what roused their wrath.」

641:t_011:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Because you are about to walk the path from evolution to $$シンカ$$.」

641:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you showed yourselves, $$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$!」

641:t_012:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll give you credit, Wingless. You have gone beyond what they expected of you.」

641:t_013:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The time has come for you, too, to learn the answer.」

641:t_013:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did $$ハーデス$$ and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and the others come after you!?」

641:t_013:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now, at last, you will learn the meaning of the fundamental calamity.」

641:t_013:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Isn't that talking about the $$サイデリアル$$...!?」

641:t_013:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are nothing more than their servants.」

641:t_013:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「They are the ones who fancy themselves rulers of this universe...!」

641:t_013:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「That one is the victor of the war of the gods...!」

641:t_013:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The one who wields $$オリジン・ロー$$ and watches over the state of every world...!」

641:t_013:11.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Who stands at the pinnacle of evolution...」

641:t_013:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「An arrogant one who will not allow others their $$シンカ$$...!」

641:t_013:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And our great enemy, who sealed the $$堕天翅$$s in the gap between dimensions 120 million years ago...!」

641:t_014:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you have come too, inferior gods.」

641:t_014:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「I knew it, you guys love having fun too, huh.」

641:t_014:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right, $n. I'm the $$ティティ$$ $n knows.」

641:t_014:6.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$ should be dead! We even saw the body!」

641:t_014:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ha ha ha! I knew it, humans just can't understand!」

641:t_014:8.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s... Eternal beings who have long since transcended death...」

641:t_014:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The $$御使い$$s...! That word... $$アイム#pilot$$ used it too...!」

641:t_014:10.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... He, too, drew close to the truth and learned of our existence.」

641:t_014:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But he was a weakling, and got taken out before he ever reached it.」

641:t_014:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the wielders of the power of God... Our name is the $$御使い$$s...」

641:t_014:14.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Be in awe... I am $$怒りのドクトリン$$.」

641:t_014:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$楽しみのテンプティ$$.」

641:t_014:16.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We serve the Supreme God, the being who is father and elder brother to all parallel worlds...」

641:t_014:17.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「In short, the one at the pinnacle of all living things... no, of everything that exists.」

641:t_014:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's the same...! The same as when we first ran into the black $$アンゲロイ$$ and the crystal monsters!」

641:t_014:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Precisely, foolish Earth species. Our existence, engraved in your genetic information, makes you feel it.」

641:t_014:22.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Ever since humanity landed on the Moon and $$クロノ$$ was born, every last human has been like $$テンプティ$$ and the others' children.」

641:t_014:25.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's exactly like the $$プロトカルチャー$$, who raised humanity's intelligence!」

641:t_014:26.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「They, too, were humans who broke a taboo.」

641:t_014:27.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「So we had them wiped out. By calling in aliens from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$ who were after $$スピリチア$$.」

641:t_014:28.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Are you talking about the $$プロトデビルン$$!?」

641:t_014:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「These guys caused the downfall of the $$プロトカルチャー$$...!」

641:t_014:30.en:
$$シモン$$
「I get it...! Now I finally get it!」

641:t_014:32.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the $$アンチスパイラル$$ feared... the despair waiting beyond evolution...」

641:t_014:34.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル$$... They were a clever race.」

641:t_014:35.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「They sealed away their own evolution, and even held down the other humans trying to evolve, didn't they.」
